motivation: Maldacena's 1997 conjecture, made precise by Witten and by Gubser, Klebanov and Polyakov, showed that a quantum theory of gravity in anti-de Sitter space is exactly equivalent to an ordinary gauge theory on its boundary. This holographic duality changed how physicists understand space, gravity and strongly coupled matter. It gave the first controlled framework for describing black-hole microstates and unitary evaporation, which culminated in recent derivations of the Page curve. It supplied quantitative tools for strongly coupled systems, from quark-gluon plasma viscosity measured at RHIC and the LHC to condensed-matter transport. It also reinterpreted warped extra-dimensional models of the hierarchy problem as duals of composite four-dimensional dynamics. Polyakov's pioneering work on strings and gauge fields anticipated the correspondence. Few ideas since the Standard Model have reshaped so many areas of physics, or given such a concrete new picture of what spacetime is.
